description: Returns changes to open and forthcoming EU grant calls on the official EU Funding & Tenders Portal: new calls, moved deadlines, status changes and removals, with before/after records. Use it to follow EU grants; use tenders_list_deadline_changes for procurement tenders and compliance_list_deadlines for legal compliance dates. Inputs (all optional, they narrow together): since (YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days ago), change (added/amended/removed), field (which field changed, e.g. deadlines), identifier (topic or call id prefix, 2 to 200 characters, e.g. HORIZON-CL5-2026), limit (1 to 50, default 20) and cursor (next_cursor, same filters). Output: changes[] with before and after topic records, official topic URL and observed_at, plus count, has_more, next_cursor and feed check time; the Portal is checked about every 6 hours. A change feed, not a catalogue of all open calls. For one topic's current record use HTTP GET /v1/eu/funding/topics/{id} (see /openapi.json). Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

change.description: One kind of change only Allowed: added, amended, removed; e.g. added.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; f followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. f0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

field.description: Only changes to this field Allowed: deadlines, status, opens, deadline_model, title, call_title, kind, url; e.g. deadlines.

identifier.description: Topic/call identifier prefix, 2 to 200 ASCII letters/digits or . _ -, e.g. HORIZON-CL5-2026; omit for all topics

since.description: Changes observed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago); e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: funding_list_changes
title: List EU funding call changes
